glosses: to be or become home to someone, something

examples.text: Diese Inseln beheimaten die verschiedensten Pflanzen- und Tierarten.
examples.translation: These islets [in the middle of the lake] are home to a wide variety of species.
examples.english: These islets [in the middle of the lake] are home to a wide variety of species.

examples.text: 2015 November 11th, Erdähnlicher Planet in kosmischer Nachbarschaft entdeckt, in Die Zeit (URL, retrieved June 1st, 2016)
examples.translation: The quest for different worlds that could be/become home to life continues therefore.
examples.english: The quest for different worlds that could be/become home to life continues therefore.

glosses: to give a person a (new) homeland/home; to make something homelike for someone

examples.translation: to give refugees, expellees a (new) homeland/home
examples.english: to give refugees, expellees a (new) homeland/home

examples.text: Die kommenden drei Adventssonntage haben die Themen „Menschen Rechte geben“, „Frieden schaffen“ und „Flüchtlinge beheimaten“.
examples.translation: The [church service on the] coming three Sundays in Advent will deal with “giving humans [their] rights”, “making peace” and “giving refugees a (new) home”.
examples.english: The [church service on the] coming three Sundays in Advent will deal with “giving humans [their] rights”, “making peace” and “giving refugees a (new) home”.

examples.text: Weniger Flüchtlinge kommen, wenn wir/die EU Tunesien, den Libanon, Jordanien, die Türkei und die irakischen Kurden substanziell und entschieden unterstützen würden, die Flüchtlinge zu beheimaten.
examples.translation: Less refugees are to come if we/the EU would substantially and resolutely support Tunisia, Lebanon, Jordan, Turkey and the Iraqi Kurds in offering [their country/land] to refugees [as] a (new) homeland/home.
examples.english: Less refugees are to come if we/the EU would substantially and resolutely support Tunisia, Lebanon, Jordan, Turkey and the Iraqi Kurds in offering [their country/land] to refugees [as] a (new) homeland/home.

examples.text: Seit der Zeit, da die Stadt Häuser bauen muss, um Flüchtlinge adäquat zu beheimaten, werden die Bürger viel aktiver als in der Vergangenheit.
examples.translation: Since that time, as the town has to build houses to adequately give refugees a (new) home, the townspeople are getting more active compared to past events.
examples.english: Since that time, as the town has to build houses to adequately give refugees a (new) home, the townspeople are getting more active compared to past events.

glosses: to give an organism a (new) habitat; to re-establish, re-introduce a species

examples.text: Abgeschirmt von Spaziergängern und intensiver Landwirtschaft haben sich auf den Übungsanlagen besonders außerhalb der intensiv genutzten Flächen ganz nebenbei Biosysteme gebildet, die fast ausgestorbene Pflanzen- und Tierarten wieder beheimaten.
examples.translation: Shielded from strolling people and intensive farming new biosystems have alongside developed on the proving grounds, especially outside of the intensively used areas, that provide for a new habitat of nearly extinct species.
examples.english: Shielded from strolling people and intensive farming new biosystems have alongside developed on the proving grounds, especially outside of the intensively used areas, that provide for a new habitat of nearly extinct species.

examples.text: Generell beanspruchten die keine Nebenbuhler duldenden Jäger ein derart großes Revier, dass der gesamten Spessart maximal 25 Luchse beheimaten könnte.
examples.translation: Generally these predators, tolerating no rivals, took up such a large territory that the entire Spessart could provide for a (new) habitat of a maximum of 25 lynxes.
examples.english: Generally these predators, tolerating no rivals, took up such a large territory that the entire Spessart could provide for a (new) habitat of a maximum of 25 lynxes.

examples.text: Wie Elche als „Landschaftspfleger“ wirksam werden, erläuterte Axel Gebauer anhand der elf bei Dauban beheimateten Elche.
examples.translation: Axel Gebauer illustrated how elks becoming effective as “conservators of the countryside” by exemplifying eleven elks re-introduced near [the locality of] Dauban.
examples.english: Axel Gebauer illustrated how elks becoming effective as “conservators of the countryside” by exemplifying eleven elks re-introduced near [the locality of] Dauban.

glosses: давать приют (беженцам и т. п.); предоставлять право убежища (иностранцу); предоставлять право гражданства (иностранцу)
jemandem oder etwas eine Heimat bieten

examples.text: Die verwahrloste Wohnung beheimatete allerlei Ungeziefer, wie Kakerlaken, Mäuse und Ratten.
Die ehemalige Industrieanlage wird in Zukunft Künstler und junge Unternehmer beheimaten.
